notes.title: Sojo Patch Notes - 20241215 - v1.1.0
notes.notes:
[b][u]Sojo Patch Notes - 20241215 - v1.1.0[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]New content![/b] The Under content phase has started and will begin with the Sewers, the first area of the new phase. Level 30 new cap, 45 new items, 17 new quests, 10 new NPCs, 8 new enemy types, 3 new level 25 traits per class, new lootable chests, and more.
[*] Isle content has had a sweep of nerfs, specifically the pre-raid tier 5 dungeons (now accessible without class spell unlocks), access to The Under is locked behind getting keyed to the Isle Raid, but all content up to that point is now solo-able with the Raid remaining unchanged in difficulty. Players may now simply choose to move to the Under if they do not have players for group content. Isle special bosses are still bosses… though with new gear maybe you can go back and solo/duo them?
[*] Large and Ultrawide screen resolutions should now function properly for the login and character select screens without stretching the viewport. 
[*] All weapon models have been revised, specifically the holding of weapons in armed mode, weapons should no longer be misaligned with character models and floating in the air magically.
[*] Legendaries and Avatar of Air weapons have had a substantial buff. More may follow with new content as these weapons are very difficult to obtain and need to persist through new content for some time.
[*] All 2H Axes have been normalized to 3 SPD.
[*] Bloody Frenzy item drops have been buffed.
[*] Light / lag issue in Isle Cave dungeon arena has been fixed. Should no longer lag and strobe while in combat.
[*] Lunar wisp and Demon encounter rate increased.
[*] Footpad and Assassin tolmark drop rates reduced.
[*] Music area trigger fixes, should no longer occasionally bug out when traversing new areas.
[*] Petable doggo in the starting town has now returned back from his hiding place. Good boy.
[/list]
[u][b]Class Changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Mage class revealed visual and animation has been updated, it should be easier to see the blocks over water, and it just looks cooler now.
[*] Rogues Footwork Trait now also grants 5 stacks of Cadence Defense on application instead of the default 3.
[/list]

notes.title: Content in The Under coming in the next few weeks, Isle pre-raid balance changes
notes.notes:
Expect the first area of The Under, the sewers, having its initial release here in the next few weeks.  New max level of 30, one new trait tier for all classes, 40~ new items, 15~ new quests, 7 new enemies, and 7 new friendly NPCs.  Along with this update will come a large sweeping nerf to the isle pre raid tier 5 group content mentioned in the August dev blog this year. Among these changes are some much needed bug fixes, including the annoying ultra widescreen login/character stretching fix.

Back in February this year I talked about doing the first content release up to the next major HUB, but I have decided I would rather go area by area, where it makes sense, and spare myself the madness of testing and bug-fixing five tiers of content all at once. We also had our best success with patches and updates when we had players actively hammering content.

I appreciate the patience of everyone following this project. I still have a lot of serious IRL stuff going on but I am at least getting some time right now to get some work done on Sojo and hopefully with this first release we will see a more consistent flow of content coming for the next year.

If you still haven't joined, follow along the #dev-blog in Discord to see the latest updates on the project: https://discord.com/invite/M6srktMM3z

notes.title: Sojo Patch Notes - 20231118 - v1.0.32
notes.notes:
- **New content!** The Guild Outpost or "starting town" has been completely revamped. This was the very first area made during development and has finally got some much needed world design updates and love. Some early quests have had small adjustments made to them. NPCs have been moved quite a bit so be sure to re-familiarize yourself with the area.
- Somewhere on the isle, a new NPC has been added with a new bag expansion quest. 
- New rare mob added to the isle with some early tier gear.
- Nighttime is now brighter. Client will now automatically adjust gamma and brightness based on time of day. Hopefully this should solve the need to constantly manually swap between gamma settings based on time of day for some players.
- Various collision and anti-cheat warp correction issues resolved.
- ALL players have had their location reset due to large terrain change around the starting town. Binds remain unchanged.

notes.title: Sojo Patch Notes - 20231004 - v1.0.31
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New content! Explore the ruins to the east of the undead tower and fire oasis to discover new powerful items, dangerous foes, and hazardous obstacles. This new area is intended to be a T5 solo area with a handful of quests and items to keep you occupied while gathering your friends to take down the harder T5 group content. Make no mistake though, even though this area is intended to be solo'd, it will punish the unprepared.
[*] Fixed minor lighting issues in dungeons across the Isle.
[*] Numerous minor network stability issues addressed.
[/list]
